svg.title: PolySocial Sprint 2 architecture
svg.desc: UI, pure domain logic, repository boundaries and external services. Green is the Sprint 2 scope including Sprint 1 foundations; blue is later backlog. Planned features are not a claim of implementation.
svg.text: Planned sprint scope, including S1 foundations · each repeated name denotes the same repository interface
cached events and tiles stay usable
search failure keeps the map pin
organizers read list · offline write refused
notice needs no new data access
Own users/{uid}; notice kept in app
implemented only by their own issues
CameraX / ML Kit for later QR flows
no continuous or precise location history
Main currently permits own private profiles and public/private event reads; event writes and attendee subcollections remain denied.
#121 must confirm capacity enforcement without exposing other attendees or allowing students to edit organizer-only event fields.
Reminders remain on the device. Mapbox rendering is the UI SDK exception; ViewModels never import Firebase, HTTP or location SDKs.
Sources: #103, #106, #111, #112, #114, #121, #123, #139 and Sprint Planning #141 · arrows mean calls / uses
